supersedes_event_identity_ambiguity: V215 event identity corrected by V220 before any completed real GA1 shard or economic PnL

opposite_break_while_retest_pending.definition: cancel a same-side pending retest only when the opposite side produces a valid breakout under its own frozen trigger semantics and the same active BREAKOUT_BUFFER transform; a mere touch or intrabar excursion that does not satisfy the frozen trigger is not an opposite break

retest_window_bars.definition: window_bars counts completed signal-timeframe bars after the original breakout availability; the breakout bar is bar zero and is not counted; reclaim must become causally available no later than the close/last source index of the Nth subsequent completed signal bar
retest_window_bars.tick_break: touch/reclaim may occur on ticks, but expiry boundary is defined by completed signal bars
retest_window_bars.close_reclaim: reclaim is recognized only by a qualifying completed-bar close within the same N-bar window

session_intervals.LONDON_NY_OVERLAP: civil-time intersection of London [08:00,16:30) and New York RTH [09:30,16:00) after IANA timezone conversion for the candidate instant
session_intervals.dst: IANA civil-time rules; source timestamp first mapped through frozen Darwinex source-clock contract

invariants: failed Boolean gate consumes completed candidate per V215 ordering
event-mask canonical position remains independent of SIGNAL_CONFIG_ID per V220 correction
